metadata.title: Counseling and complaints
metadata.classification_notes: Explains counselling and complaint options for discrimination cases. Student-facing and actionable support information.

support_info.scope: Explains counselling and complaint options for discrimination cases. Student-facing and actionable support information.

content.full_text: Central Anti-Discrimination Office The Central Anti-Discrimination Office is the contact point for reporting cases of discrimination and receives complaints. Meryem Yildiz Email: Antidiskriminierung@HTW-Berlin.de Telephone: +49 30 5019-2415 Advisory Services for Employees Staff Council Women’s and Equal Opportunities Officer https://www.htw-berlin.de/einrichtungen/vertretungen-beauftragte/personalrat/ Disability Representative (Representative for Severely Disabled Employees) Psychological counselling for employees https://wiki.rz.htw-berlin.de/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=329386584 Mediation (conflict resolution ) Student Advisory Services General Student Advisory Service Equal Opportunities Officer for Women Officer for Chronically Ill and Disabled Students Psychological Counselling ( and links to external counselling centres) Social Affairs Departement of General Student Committee of HTW Berlin, asta-soziales@students-htw.de Student members of the Faculty Councils The Faculty Councils (listed online on the faculty websites under “Contact”) also always include student members who represent the interests of the students in the faculty. Family Support Centre HTW Berlin Confidentiality Team The HTW Berlin’s Confidentiality Team supports the Central Anti-Discrimination Office in processing complaints of discrimination.
